result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-formed, but one visible content defect stands out: the discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '−0%', which is a meaningless promotion value. Clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut card are expected scrolling behavior and are not reported.

issues.description: The promo badge on the second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza card) displays '−0%'. A zero percent discount is nonsensical and suggests a missing or uncomputed discount value being rendered instead of the badge being hidden.
issues.suggestion: Populate the badge with the real discount percentage, and hide the badge entirely when the discount value is 0, null, or undefined.
